# Vishva ERP — Full Content Digest

This file is the complete, unabridged content reference for Vishva ERP. It exists so that
AI assistants and retrieval systems can answer questions accurately without scraping the
site or guessing. Companion file: `/llms.txt` (curated navigation map).

Canonical site: https://vishvaerp.vercel.app
Version: 2.1.0 · Academic year reference: 2026-27 · Last updated: 2026-10-23

---

## 1. What Vishva ERP is

Vishva ERP is a **campus-grade operating system for modern institutions** — an enterprise,
multi-tenant SaaS platform for colleges, universities, school groups, coaching centres and
vocational training organisations.

Tagline: *"Run your entire campus from one intelligent platform."*

Vishva ERP unifies admissions, timetable planning, smart attendance, examinations, fee
management, HR, logistics, and analytics into a single connected system. Headline claims on
the landing page are: **Multi-campus ready · Role-based controls · Real-time workflows ·
AI-powered**.

**It is a multi-tenant SaaS, not a single college.** One backend serves many isolated
institutions (tenants). Data, settings and portals are scoped per institution. A
demonstration instance shows AY 2026-27, a campus command centre, live biometric telemetry
from Gate FaceID terminals, turnstiles and lecture halls, and figures such as 50K+ active
users, 200+ colleges and 99.9% uptime.

Onboarding is positioned as: **Free to start · No credit card required · Setup in minutes.**

---

## 2. Product pillars

1. **Dynamic Timetable Engine** — Live weekly grids, next-class signals, room movement,
   faculty workload, and day-wise academic flow.
2. **Consent-Based Smart Attendance** — Classroom geofences, teacher presence, live student
   heartbeat, source badges, and manual override.
3. **Real-Time AI Academic Layer** — AI Tutor, notes, exam support, risk summaries, and
   action queues connected to ERP operations.
4. **Institution Command Center** — One command centre for every campus decision; replaces
   scattered spreadsheets with a live operating layer for academics, revenue, compliance
   and student success. Includes admission-to-alumni lifecycle, role and tenant isolation,
   and predictive action queues.
5. **Executive operations** — Admission-to-alumni lifecycle (applications, enrollment,
   sections, certificates, alumni records), role/tenant isolation, predictive action queues
   (attendance shortages, fee risk, assignment backlog, leave load).

---

## 3. ERP modules (full descriptions)

Core modules designed for repeated operational use, not brochure screens. Each area connects
to the same data.

| Module | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Admissions & Enrollment** | Lead capture, application review, document checks, seat allocation, and parent accounts. |
| **Attendance & Timetable** | Batch-wise schedules, shortage alerts, smart location, faculty workload, and live class links. |
| **Exams & Results** | Subject plans, marks entry, grading, CGPA, bulk uploads, and parent/student views. |
| **Fees & Finance** | Fee heads, dues, receipts, partial payments, reminders, collection charts, and risk lists. |
| **HR, Leave & Payroll** | Staff profiles, leave approvals, department capacity, HR alerts, and payroll-ready records. |
| **Hostel & Transport** | Rooms, routes, vehicles, allocations, capacity tracking, and transport communication. |
| **Communications** | Notices, broadcasts, real-time messages, parent alerts, and audit trails. |
| **AI Tools Hub** | Exam generation, notes, doubt solving, insight summaries, and admin automation. |

### Connected operations

Every department works from the same record. Admissions become student records, timetable
slots become attendance sessions, results become parent visibility, and fees become finance
dashboards.

Flow: Admissions (applications to enrollment) → Academics (courses, timetable, classes) →
Attendance (manual and smart signals) → Finance (dues, receipts, collections) → Analytics
(risk, readiness, decisions).

### Demonstration command centre figures

The landing page renders a live-telemetry demo containing: active learners (live DB),
attendance biometric sync percentage, fee collection ledger sync, active faculty & staff,
and a real-time biometric & campus stream fed from Gate FaceID terminals, turnstiles and
lecture halls. Each row carries Student/Faculty identity, department and PRN (e.g.
`PRN-2026-CS108`), terminal mode (FaceID Gate, Smart RFID Swipe, Geofence QR, Biometric
Scan), room/location with verification status, and a Present/Absent state. The fees engine
shows transaction IDs (e.g. `TXN-BATCH-841`), course/semester categories, amounts, payment
method (UPI, Net Banking) and settlement status, plus automated dues recovery: smart
reminders before grace-period expiry sent over WhatsApp & SMS, and an auto-receipt
generator issuing GST-compliant 80G tax receipts.

---

## 4. AI and analytics (full description)

Vishva ERP combines live operational data with AI-assisted workflows so administrators see
what needs attention before it becomes a problem.

- **Attendance shortage prediction** before exam eligibility deadlines.
- **Fee collection prioritization** by amount, due date, and student risk.
- **AI-generated exam papers, notes, summaries, and student doubt support.**
- **Executive reporting** across colleges, departments, roles, plans, and revenue.

### Campus predictive intelligence model

Deep-learning models tracking student retention, academic performance risk, and exam
scheduling (model v4.2, shown as Active):

- **Dropout Risk Prediction** — Identifies multi-factor risk (attendance drops + test score
  declines + fee delays) roughly **60 days before semester exams**, with an advertised
  96.4% early prediction accuracy.
- **Conflict-Free Exam Timetabler** — Genetic-algorithm scheduling of examinations across
  courses, invigilators and exam halls with zero overlap (demo: 480 courses, 140
  invigilators, 36 halls, 100% conflict-free).
- **Live AI Recommendations** — Remedial class suggestions for flagged students, plus
  attendance/fee/timetable balancing hints.

### AI Action Queue

Generated from live ERP signals. Example rows: students below 75% attendance (notify mentors
and parents today); INR 8.2L due in the next 7 days (send fee reminders to high-value
pending accounts); departments needing timetable balancing where faculty workload exceeds
the target threshold.

---

## 5. Role portals

Different users, one connected source of truth. Every stakeholder gets the workspace they
need while administrators keep centralised governance.

| Role | Workspace |
| --- | --- |
| **Super Admin** | Tenant control, system health, plan management, broadcast tools, and audit logs. |
| **College Admin** | Run admissions, faculty, students, fees, logistics, notices, courses, and HR. |
| **Faculty** | Attendance, grading, live classes, assignments, leave, timetable, and AI support. |
| **Student** | Courses, attendance, assignments, fees, live classes, library, results, and AI tutor. |
| **Parent** | Ward profile, attendance, results, fee status, notices, and mentor messages. |

---

## 6. Security and governance

Designed for institutional control, privacy, and auditability. Vishva ERP keeps sensitive
academic, financial, and attendance data inside role-aware workflows. **Smart attendance is
consent-based.**

- Scoped access for Super Admin, College Admin, Faculty, Student and Parent users.
- Full audit trail for attendance, fees, exams, notices, leaves and communication.
- Privacy-first smart attendance with student consent and classroom geofence signals.
- Tenant-aware data model for institutions, departments, users and role portals.

Governance readiness panel: Enterprise · Role-based access Enabled · Smart attendance
consent **Required** · Action auditability Live · Multi-campus separation Ready.

---

## 7. Deployment models

Fit for single colleges and university networks. Use the same platform for a focused campus
rollout or a larger multi-institution command layer.

1. **College ERP** — For single colleges and autonomous institutions modernizing daily
   administration. Core campus suite.
2. **University Network** *(Recommended)* — For multi-campus groups needing central oversight
   with isolated institutional workspaces. Advanced analytics and governance.
3. **School & Training** — For schools, coaching, vocational academies, and training
   organizations with role portals. Flexible academic operations.

### Implementation path

Move from setup to daily operations quickly — start with the core ERP and expand into
intelligence, automation and campus-wide communication:

1. **Create tenant** — Institution, admins, plan, departments.
2. **Load master data** — Students, faculty, courses, batches.
3. **Run operations** — Attendance, fees, notices, exams.
4. **Connect users** — Student, faculty, parent portals.
5. **Optimize with AI** — Insights, reports, recommendations.

### Multi-platform access

Built mobile-first. Whether you are a student checking attendance or an administrator
approving leaves, the experience is fast, native and always in sync. One codebase means app
and web always have the latest features. Role-based notifications deliver native alerts for
fee dues, exam results and academic notices. End-to-end encryption with role-based access
controls.

Distribution channels:

- **Instant Install (PWA)** — Best for browser-based native experience.
- **Android APK** — Full native shell for power users (~15 MB, v2.1.0, updated Jul 2026).
- **iOS** — Tap Share in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen" to install.

Native shells are built from the same web codebase via Capacitor, so web updates reach
mobile instantly.

## 8. Sign-in page (`/pages/login.html`)

*"The complete ERP built for educational institutions — managing thousands of students,
faculty, and operations in one place."*

Feature bullets shown: role-based access for 5 user types · real-time timetable & slot
allocation · live attendance command center · automated clash & conflict auditing ·
multi-college support with complete isolation. Social proof strip: 50K+ active users,
200+ colleges, 99.9% uptime, 24/7 support.

Sign-in methods:

- **Email / password** with optional "Remember me" and "Trust this device for 30 days".
- **OTP over email** — 6-digit code with resend timer.
- **OTP over phone / WhatsApp** — requires country code, e.g. `+919876543210`.
- **Social OAuth** — Google, Microsoft, GitHub.

The page includes a role prefill demo ("⚡ Quick Demo: Click any role below to prefill
credentials") covering Super Admin, College Admin, Faculty, Student and Parent, plus
rate-limit and invalid-credential messaging.

---

## 9. Registration page (`/pages/register.html`)

Four-step wizard: **1 Role → 2 Details → 3 Security → 4 Verify**.

1. **Select Your Role** — College Admin (manage your entire institution), Faculty (classes,
   attendance, assignments, grades), Student (courses, assignments, results, campus
   services), Parent (monitor your child's academic progress and fee status).
2. **Personal Details** — Full name, phone number, college/institution name, email address,
   optional referral code. Social signup via Microsoft/GitHub also offered.
3. **Secure Your Account** — Password with validation rules: 8+ characters, uppercase,
   lowercase, number, special character, passwords must match. Agreement to Terms of Service
   and Privacy Policy required.
4. **Verify Your Email** — 6-digit code with resend timer.

Success state: *"Your college workspace is ready with a 30-day free trial."*

---

## 10. Privacy policy (`/pages/legal/privacy.html`)

**Last Updated: June 27, 2026.**

**1. Data Collection** — Vishva ERP collects institutional and personal data necessary for
academic operations, including but not limited to names, emails, roll numbers, attendance
records, and financial transactions.

**2. Native App & Push Notifications** — The Android and iOS applications collect device
tokens to provide real-time campus alerts. We do not track user location in the background.
Location data is only used with explicit consent for smart classroom attendance.

**3. Data Security** — We employ enterprise-grade encryption for all data at rest and in
transit. Institutional data is isolated using multi-tenant architecture.

---

## 11. Public API surface

Base: `https://vishvaerp.vercel.app/api/v1/`

- `GET /api/health` — Unauthenticated service health check (service name, version, uptime).
- `GET /api/health/db` — MongoDB connectivity check.
- Versioned REST modules mirror the ERP areas: attendance, exams, exam-generator, ai,
  assignments, timetable, fees, leave/hr, logistics, transport, hostel, complaints/grievance,
  live-classes, academics, notices, public, auth, super-admin, college-admin, quizzes,
  placements, library, inventory and others. All data endpoints require authentication and
  are scoped to the caller's institution and role.
- `/api/` (unversioned) aliases remain for backward compatibility; responses carry
  `X-API-Deprecation` headers. Prefer `/api/v1/`.

Live site configuration: the web tier is served by Vercel and rewrites `/api/*`, `/uploads/*`
and `/socket.io/*` to the Node/Express + Socket.io backend, giving a single origin for
browsers. The backend runs MongoDB (capped collections for real-time streams), Redis-backed
job queues for analytics refresh, and JWT auth with refresh-token rotation.

## 13. Indexing policy (important for crawlers)

Only four pages are intended for search-engine indexing:

- `/` (home)
- `/pages/login.html`
- `/pages/register.html`
- `/pages/legal/privacy.html`

Every other page (dashboards, chat, AI hub, role portals) is login-gated and deliberately
marked `noindex, nofollow`, because the content is not meaningful without an authenticated
session. This is intentional, not a crawl error. Use this file and `/llms.txt` as the
authoritative source for product capability questions.
